field.label: Enable Service
field.help: Enable the background Podman system service daemon and socket.

field.label: Enable Linux Emulation
field.help: Automatically load FreeBSD 64-bit Linux kernel modules (linux64.ko, linprocfs, linsysfs) to allow running Linux container images.

field.label: Listen Address
field.help: IP address for the TCP Docker API socket (e.g. 127.0.0.1 or 0.0.0.0).

field.label: Listen Port
field.help: Port number for the TCP Docker API socket (default 2376).

field.label: Enable TLS
field.help: Require TLS authentication for the TCP Docker API socket.

field.label: Server Certificate
field.help: Select the SSL/TLS server certificate from System: Trust: Certificates.
